english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an alarm clock.
Use this specifically for an alarm clock that wakes someone up.

examples.english: I have an early shift tomorrow, so I’ll remember to set the alarm clock tonight.
examples.traditional: 我聽朝要返早更，今晚記得校好個鬧鐘先。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 ziu1 jiu3 faan2 zou2 gaang1 gam1 maan5 gei3 dak1 haau6 hou2 go3 naau6 zung1 sin1

examples.english: My alarm clock didn't go off this morning, so I was late.
examples.traditional: 我個鬧鐘今朝冇響，搞到我遲到。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 naau6 zung1 gam1 ziu1 mou5 hoeng2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 dou3
